description: This Java interface defines the contract for handling retirement actions on Retireable objects within the OpenMRS framework. It specifies the handle method to mark objects as retired, set retirement reasons, and record who retired and when.

classes.name: RetireHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling retirement actions on Retireable objects, extending RequiredDataHandler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Implements the logic to set an object as retired, including setting retire reason, user, and date.
